evidence: decorative_mascot: A SECOND mascot is parked in the identical spot holding a clipboard from seg1:mid through payoff@-0.4 (f08-f20), never moving, doing no bit — while the performing mascot acts above it; that lower clone is pure decoration for 40+ seconds.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg1:mid and seg1:end the scene stacks four unrelated layers in the same pixels: the kicker 'it never settled' overlaps the standing title 'how many couples are sleeping apart', a bright blue zig-zag polyline is drawn straight across that title, a capsule with a red dot floats mid-frame beside a stray empty ellipse, the label 'anywhere between 29% and 35%' collides with a mascot on the right edge, and a second mascot plus the caption 'third: 35 percent' occupy the lower third — nothing in the frame can be read cleanly.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The range/dial machine is composited without a layout pass: its line, its capsule and its annotation are placed in absolute coordinates that ignore the reserved title band and the caption band, and a second mascot instance is drawn on top of the first scene's mascot instead of replacing it.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Rebuild seg1 so the range reads as one claim: keep ONE mascot, drop the stray polyline and the empty ellipse, move the 29%-35% capsule into the clear middle band with its endpoint labels outside any other element, and reserve the top band for the title alone so no text overlaps text.
